tasks.items: S56 "Expert rulings on the handback" items 1, 2, 7; Order (2026-11-23) step 4 main run

failure_policy: M1-M5 failure: stop and report (harness or wiring fault). A harness fault (exception, guard mismatch, child exit != 0, an initialisation-identity mismatch raised by the harness) is recorded and stops the order. P3-P9: recorded, never re-run or tuned. The cycle-40 stop rule as in (iv)

alpha.how: interface_deviation_premium not declared: admm_parameters default {'alpha': 0.0}; model_construction_helpers.add_scenario_commitment_terms builds row 18 only when premium_alpha > 0, so row18_charge_reactive is inert

V1.aa: forced off by production under the option
V1.role: calibration arm; formulation of record (Expert ruling 2)

V2.aa: forced off by production under the option
V2.role: V-2 is a measured, non-deciding arm. (Expert ruling 2, variant (b))

pinned_aa_off.aa: off via the harness AA override
pinned_aa_off.role: control (option off, AA off via the harness override)

configuration.note: S56 step 4 smoke: the G-f / step 4 build configuration (p515_s56_coupling_gates.py literals) on the derived instance; no row 18 declaration (production default alpha 0.0), no model variant, no flex variant, no NRF, no rho0 scale, no post-certification

i_arms_instances_cap.execution_order: instance B: one campaign, its four arms concurrent (concurrency 4); then instance A: one campaign, its four arms concurrent. The harness campaign lock is one per checkout and the derived instance is campaign-level, so A cannot run concurrently with B; the task's memory rule for starting A during B is therefore moot (A runs after B, its stated fallback). vm_stat recorded before and during each campaign
i_arms_instances_cap.stopping: production: a cycle converges when every Boyd channel passes and every local solve succeeded; the run stops after required_consecutive_cycles (10) consecutive converged cycles or at the cap. The convergence-depth tail (compl_inf_tol 1e-6) is active in cycle k+1 iff cycle k converged (production _convergence_depth_tail_next_state; not sticky)
i_arms_instances_cap.v2_declaration: V-2 is a measured, non-deciding arm.

ii_central_and_allowance.allowance_rule: e_b <= (R/4) x w_b / Sigma_12 w (S56_PLAN_v4 section 3)

2025|Summer.source: step 3 v2 S3-2 merged-default solution (185,674.1557530493 EUR/day); Planner ruling at 98b7f597: labelled merged-only (bias +0.035 EUR/day on 26 pairs), not used for calibration

iii_tail_depth_only.cross_check: the S56 capture line of cycle k (read after the cycle's solves) records the options in force for the NEXT cycle's solves; recorded beside, never used to classify
iii_tail_depth_only.rule: calibration and acceptance on tail-depth cycles only (Expert X4-2 (a)); the production-depth floor (D-1: +597.67 EUR 2025|Winter, +499.03 EUR 2035|Summer, one-signed) is reported as a limitation
iii_tail_depth_only.tail_depth_cycle: cycle k (k >= 1) is tail-depth iff every record of round k in the run's network_ipopt_solve_records.jsonl (agents TSO, DSO5, DSO7, DSO9; every attempt) has compl_inf_tol_in_force == 1e-6, and there is at least one such record

iv_cycle40_look.fit: ordinary least squares of ln|e_b(k)| = a + k ln r on cycles 21..34; validated on the held-out cycles 35..40: the held-out error is max over those cycles of |ln(|e_hat(k)| / |e_b(k)|)| (recorded with the predicted and observed values); the projection refits on cycles 21..40
iv_cycle40_look.projection: k_star = 40 + ln(allowance_b / |e_hat(40)|) / ln r when r < 1 and |e_hat(40)| > allowance; k_star = 40 when |e_hat(40)| <= allowance; k_star = infinity when r >= 1
iv_cycle40_look.recorded_beside_not_deciding: the same fit on e_b(k) - F_b with F_b the D-1 production-depth floor (the cycles of the look are production-depth until the first Boyd pass); the tail-depth classification of cycles 1..40
iv_cycle40_look.stop_rule: if k_star > 600 on a calibrated block, STOP AND REPORT: the running campaign is terminated through the harness's own interrupt path (SIGINT to the launcher parent; the harness SIGTERMs and reaps its children, records written up to the stop are kept) and nothing further is launched. Otherwise continue
iv_cycle40_look.what: per calibrated block b of the instance (A: 2025|Winter; B: 2035|Summer), e_b(k) = Q_b(k) - w_b x C_central, Q_b = V-1 capture q_blocks.per_year_day[b].settlement_excluded_in_full
iv_cycle40_look.when: once V-1 of the instance has written its cycle-40 capture line (or the run ended before 40)

m3.equality: canonical json.dumps(sort_keys=True) of each line / record with the excluded keys removed recursively; floats compare by their JSON repr (exact round trip)

files.network_ipopt_solve_records.jsonl: every record of rounds 0..3, in file order
files.per_cycle_record.jsonl: every cycle line 1..3 (keys present in both files; keys present in one only are listed)
files.s56_cycle_capture.jsonl: coupled arms only (the smoke pinned arms had no capture): cycle lines 1..3, header excluded, the field voltage_pin (added by a662c9bf, absent from the smoke file) listed not compared

m3.smoke_counterpart: the smoke run of the same instance and arm (spec e36c29bd, root campaign_s56s4smoke_v2_<inst>_<arm>)

measured_vs_projected: every reported value is labelled measured, fitted or projected
memory_rule: record vm_stat (free + inactive GiB) before each campaign and during it (at the cycle-40 look and at least hourly while a campaign runs)
not_permitted: any run not in this spec
objective_convention: Q in EUR of total discounted cost. Coupled arms: primary gross_operational_cost = settlement excluded in full (pin excluded, salvage separate), contracted-excluded beside it. Pinned arms: gross_operational_cost = contracted settlement and pin excluded. C_central: step 3 gross EUR/day (settlement weight 0, no row 18, no pin, no salvage). e_b(k) = Q_b(k) - w_b C_central and D_b = w_b C_central - Q_pin,b in EUR of total discounted cost

predecessor.relation: the step 4 smoke spec v2 (e36c29bd). This addendum adds the main run on the same arms, instances, configuration and candidate; the pinned arms add the per-cycle capture key s56_cycle_capture_pinned (a662c9bf). Nothing in the smoke spec is edited

solves.per_run: per_round x (cycles_run + 1) + every recovery retry actually attempted (credited per failure event by the solve_profile identity)

stage: P5.15 S56 validation step 4 MAIN RUN: arms V-1, V-2 (measured, non-deciding), pinned AA-off, pinned AA-on on instance A (2025|Winter) and instance B ({2025, 2035} x Summer); x0, alpha 0, cap 300; cycle-40 look; continuation to 600 declared

v_continuation.arms: V-1; V-2 too if it is still contracting at cycle 300
v_continuation.budget_guard: launched only if the measured wall of the step 4 runs so far plus the projected continuation wall (measured s/cycle x 600) stays inside the author's 20 h; otherwise stop and report (machine allocation is the author's)
v_continuation.condition: per instance and arm: the cap-300 run has not settled (record certification.certified is not True, i.e. it stopped at the cap) AND its fitted contraction rate r < 1, where r is the OLS rate of ln|Q_b(k) - Q_b(k-1)| (V-1: of ln|e_b(k)|) on cycles 261..300, per calibrated block; V-2 "still contracting" means the same step-rate fit gives r < 1 on its calibrated block
v_continuation.how: a NEW campaign root campaign_s56s4main_v1_cont600_<inst> (labels x0_<arm>_cont600), fresh runs from cycle 1 with the same code, configuration and seeding (the harness has no generic resume); its cycles 1..300 are compared with the cap-300 run (recorded), its cycles 1..3 with the smoke (M3)
v_continuation.when: after both main campaigns, from the same launcher and spec

also_record: M1 for V-1 vs V-2: the Delta V_s trajectory (max and omega-RMS)
M4 effort: cycles and wall time to the same per-block error level
per run, the terminal-step-to-threshold ratio (CLAUDE.md rule)
the settling bars S per block, in validated extrapolation form

the working level: the loosest Boyd tolerance at which the V-1 per-block error stays <= allowance at every later tail-depth cycle, also expressed as per-block observables (max and omega-RMS of Delta P_s, Delta Q_s, Delta V_s, and A_b)

must_hold.M1: F1 identities every cycle in the coupled arms: PR price part + settlement total = 0, to rel 1e-9; contracted - primary = deviation total, to rel 1e-9; Sigma_s omega_s mu_s = 0, to 1e-9 x max|mu|; V-1 pin total == 0.
must_hold.M2: Initialisation identity: pinned AA-off == pinned AA-on == V-2, bitwise; V-1 forms its own group.
must_hold.M3: Every run's first 3 cycles are bitwise equal to its serial smoke counterpart, with timing fields excluded in advance. This checks concurrency and continuation equivalence.
must_hold.M4: Capture-path assertions hold, and the per-block Q sums equal production's Q to rel 1e-12, every cycle, in every arm.

vi_predictions.must_hold_failure: a harness or wiring fault: stop and report (stated with the local-solution caveat: these are identities and equalities of the implementation, not optimality claims)

operational.M1: coupled arms (V1, V2), every cycle: (i) rel(priced_residual_price_part_c, -T_c) <= 1e-9, T_c = sum over agent blocks of weight x settlement_total_unweighted (capture); (ii) rel(gross_operational_cost_contracted_excluded_c - gross_operational_cost_c, D_c) <= 1e-9, D_c = sum over agent blocks of weight x (settlement_total_unweighted - settlement_contracted_unweighted), plus the DSO decomposition against per_cycle_response covariance_dso_weighted <= 1e-9 every cycle and against the record's interface_settlement_deviation_total at the terminal cycle; (iii) every deviation-dual coordinate of interface_duals_per_cycle.jsonl: |sum_s omega_s mu_s| <= 1e-9 x max|mu| (per cycle, agent, kind); (iv) V1: the capture's voltage_pin.total == 0.0 and every voltage_pin.per_agent weighted == 0.0 with pin_constructed False, EVERY cycle (a662c9bf field), and the terminal record voltage_pin_total == 0.0. rel = |a - b| / max(|a|, |b|, 1)
operational.M2: per instance: the main V2, pinned_aa_off and pinned_aa_on initialisation records have equal gross_operational_cost_hex and equal components_hex, equal to the smoke V2 / pinned records' hex; every harness comparison of these three has all_equal True and n_compared >= 1; main V1 group "voltage_pin_not_constructed", its hex equal to the smoke V1 hex and different from the V2 hex, compared only within its group
operational.M3: per run: the files and exclusions of the spec's "m3" block; held iff every compared item is equal
operational.M4: every arm: the record's s56_cycle_capture_checklist_asserted_before_run all True (coupled: the coupled checklist; pinned: the pinned checklist), s56_cycle_capture_summary ok with cycle_lines_written == cycles_run, no capture line with captured False; per cycle rel(sum over (year, day) of the arm's primary Q, per_cycle_record gross_operational_cost) <= 1e-12
operational.M4_effort: V1 and V2, each calibrated block: the first cycle after which |Q_b(k) - Q_hat_inf_b| <= allowance_b at every later cycle (each arm against its own extrapolated limit), the cumulative cycle_wall_s to it, and cycles x wall ratios V1 / V2
operational.M5: every run: solve_profile.identity_holds True, base_solves == per_round x (cycles_run + 1), blocked_solve == blocked_exec == 0, exit code 0 (parent view and exit_code.txt); launcher guard 0
operational.P3: V1, each calibrated block: T = the tail-depth cycles of the run (cap-300 run, and the continuation when run). Held iff |e_b(K)| <= allowance_b at the last tail-depth cycle K. Recorded: min over T of |e_b|, its cycle, R_eff = 4 x min|e_b| x Sigma_12 w / w_b, and the dominant term = the largest of {S_b (settling bar, tail-depth cycles), |PR_b(K)| (full-channel priced residual), the D-1 tail-depth floor}. If T is empty: not evaluable (recorded with the production-depth values)
operational.P4: D_b = w_b C_central - Q_pin,b(K), K the last cycle of the pinned AA-off run (contracted-excluded), its bar = S_b of that run. Recorded: D_b >= 0 on 2035|Summer; |D_b(2025|Winter)| <= |D_b(2035|Summer)| / 3 ("much smaller", operationalised so); a negative D_b is not a defect (Expert ruling 7)
operational.P5: V2, each calibrated block: lim Q_V2,b = the validated extrapolation Q_hat_inf on the run's tail-depth cycles (the terminal value, labelled, when no validated extrapolation exists); held iff lim Q_V2,b - w_b (C_central + Delta_pin_b) <= S_b(V2); the local-solution caveat is stated beside
operational.P6: per instance: r_pf,exp(k) = sqrt(sum over blocks, periods, kinds p and q of ((x_dso - z_tso) / rating_MVA)^2) from the capture's primal_expectation (the same formula for every arm; for the coupled arms it reproduces production's boyd_pf_r_expectation_part, checked). L = max over the four arms of min_k r_pf,exp(k). cycles(arm) = first k with r_pf,exp(k) <= L; wall(arm) = mean cycle_wall_s over cycles 1..cycles(arm). Held iff 1.0 <= cycles(V1)/cycles(AA-off) <= 2.0 and 0.9 <= wall(V1)/wall(AA-off) <= 1.2 and cycles(AA-off)/cycles(AA-on) >= 2; the V2 ratios recorded beside
operational.P7: V1, each calibrated block, cycles k >= 21: PR_b(k) = price_b(k) + sum over DNs and periods of [lambda_P dPbar + lambda_Q dQbar] x w_b eff_b / (s_T R) + lambda_V dVbar x w_b eff_b / v_b^2 + sum_s omega_s [(mu_P,s dP_s + mu_Q,s dQ_s) x w_b eff_b / (s_T R) + mu_V,s dV_s x w_b eff_b / v_b^2], with lambda / mu the TSO-side stored expectation / deviation duals (interface_duals_per_cycle.jsonl lambda_pf_*_tso, lambda_dev_*_tso; capture dual_expectation_v tso), dXbar = TSO - DSO expectation copies (capture), dX_s = (xbar_T + d_T,s) - (xbar_D + d_D,s) (capture expectation + deviation copies; MW, MVAr, kV), eff_b, s_T and R from the interface-dual header metadata (admm_objective_scale_tso, tso_base_mva, interface_rating_mva), v_b the interface base kV (= capture kV / interface_voltage_terminal pu, checked constant), price_b(k) = -sum over the block's agents of weight x settlement_total_unweighted. The P-deviation part is validated against production's priced_residual_dual_part (sum over blocks, rel 1e-9 every cycle). Held iff sum_{k >= 21} |Q_b + PR_b - w_b C| <= (1/5) sum_{k >= 21} |Q_b - w_b C| on every calibrated block; the per-cycle ratios recorded
operational.P8: per run: K1 = the first tail-depth cycle; the step Q(K1) - Q(K1 - 1) total and per block (EUR); "no tail onset" when none
operational.P9: per child: record peak_rss.child_python_process_ru_maxrss <= 6 GiB; IPOPT maximum beside
operational.Q_b: per cycle, from the run's s56_cycle_capture.jsonl q_blocks.per_year_day[b]: coupled arms settlement_excluded_in_full (contracted_excluded beside), pinned arms contracted_excluded
operational.S_b: validated extrapolation on the last W = min(20, n) cycles of the window (V1 calibration: tail-depth cycles only; other uses: the run's last cycles): steps delta_k = Q_b(k) - Q_b(k-1) on consecutive cycles; OLS ln|delta_k| = a + k ln r on the window minus its last h = 3 cycles; validated by predicting Q_b on the h held-out cycles (geometric sum from the last fitted cycle), H = max |predicted - observed|; refit on the whole window, Q_hat_inf = Q_b(K) + delta_K r / (1 - r); S_b = |Q_hat_inf - Q_b(K)| + H. Valid only with >= 6 steps of one sign and r < 1; otherwise S_b = the range of Q_b over the last 10 cycles, labelled "range (no validated extrapolation)"
operational.dV_trajectory: V1 and V2, every cycle: production scenario_mismatch_v_max_pu and _rms_pu (pooled) and, per block, the max and omega-RMS of dV_s from the capture
operational.local_solve_failures: per run: record local_solve_failures and per-cycle non_optimal_blocks
operational.terminal_step_to_threshold: per run: record rule_ten.terminal_step_over_threshold (objective change / objective tolerance, reported-not-gated) and the terminal Boyd ratio max per channel
operational.working_level: V1, each calibrated block: m(k) = max over channels v, pf, ess of max(primal_ratio, dual_ratio) (per_cycle_record; production tolerance = 1). For a level s, k_s = the first tail-depth cycle with m(k) <= s. Working level s* = the largest s (over the observed m values at tail-depth cycles) such that |e_b(k)| <= allowance_b at every tail-depth cycle k >= k_s. Expressed at k_s*: s*, k_s*, and the block's max and omega-RMS of dP_s, dQ_s, dV_s (capture), and A_b = the absolute form of PR_b (sum of absolute terms); "not attained" when no s qualifies

recorded.P3: On tail-depth cycles, V-1's e_b(k) contracts to <= the block allowance. If it does not, report the smallest |e_b| reached, R_eff = 4 x |e_b| x Sigma_12 w / w_b, and the dominant term, before anything touches R.
recorded.P4: D_b = w_b x C_central - Q_pin,b (pinned AA-off, contracted-excluded): D_b >= 0 on 2035|Summer, and |D_b| on 2025|Winter much smaller. Expert ruling 7 applies: D_b is pinned accounting optimism (>= 0) plus DN re-optimisation gain (<= 0). A negative value is not a defect.
recorded.P5: lim Q_V2 <= w_b x (C_central + Delta_pin) + bars, where Delta_pin is 0.4056 EUR/day on 2025|Winter and 4.8856 EUR/day on 2035|Summer. This is subject to the local-solution caveat.
recorded.P6: At a matched expectation-channel residual: cycles F1 / pinned AA-off between 1.0 and 2.0; wall time per cycle between 0.9 and 1.2; AA-off / AA-on >= 2.
recorded.P7: After the run, PR over all channels (recomputed from the capture) reduces |Q_k - w x C| at least fivefold after cycle 20.
recorded.P8: The Q step at tail onset is recorded per run.
